## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Zhāntuóyuè guówáng jīng* (T518) is a one-fascicle short sūtra by [沮渠京聲](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B2%AE%E6%B8%A0%E4%BA%AC%E8%81%B2) Jǔqú Jīngshēng. The protagonist *Zhāntuóyuè* 旃陀越 (also written 旃陀掘) is a phonetic transliteration possibly of *Caṇḍrāvatī* or another Indic toponym.

**Abstract**

A short *avadāna*-style narrative on a king's encounter with the Buddha. Translation dated to Jǔqú Jīngshēng's productive period (455–464 CE).
